hero_lead: Inclusive yoga classes with a non-perfection mindset. A genuine yoga experience for real people.
timetable_intro: From energising mornings to relaxing evenings, choose the sessions that fit your schedule.
welcome_one: Forget the idea that you need to be flexible, experienced or confident before you begin. Our teachers meet you exactly where you are, helping you build your practice at your own pace.
welcome_two: Built for the yoga-curious, not the yoga-perfect. With hot yoga, gentle classes, Pilates, Barre and more, you'll find a class that fits your body, your goals and your week.
principles_intro: The studio is built on four simple things. They shape every class and every welcome at the door.
principle_welcoming: A community with a class for everyone, in a safe space to be yourself and make friends.
principle_dedicated: A reliable schedule and an easy booking system. We make showing up simple.
principle_passion: Inspiring teachers who are genuinely excited to share what they love, every class.
principle_integrity: We do things the right way, on and off the mat, even when no one is looking.
ways_intro: Whether you're trying your first class or ready to make yoga part of your routine, there's an option to suit you..
